parameters.query:
insert into audit_log (report_id, actor, action, diff)
select $1::uuid, $2, 'acknowledged', $3::jsonb
 where exists (select 1 from reports where id = $1::uuid)
returning report_id, action, actor, at

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: $json.at !== undefined, report_id: $('Validate acknowledgement').first().json.report_id, employee_id: $('Validate acknowledgement').first().json.employee_id, actor: $('Validate acknowledgement').first().json.reviewer, at: $json.at || null }) }}
